title: Paper Moons
style: Dreamy melancholic indie electronic melodic house, 116 BPM, warm plucked synths, gentle rolling groove, soft deep bass, hazy reverb pads, intimate soft male and female duet vocals trading lines and harmonizing, bittersweet late-night feeling
negativeTags: rock, metal, country, aggressive, distorted, EDM drop, rap
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - Male]
We cut out paper moons
And hung them on the wall
Pretending they were real
Before the ceiling falls

[Verse 1 - Female]
You hum a half-remembered tune
I fill the empty space
We fold the quiet into shapes
That time cannot erase

[Chorus - Duet]
Paper moons, glowing soft and low
Holding on to what we used to know
Paper moons, fragile as a sigh
Light enough to drift across the sky

[Bridge - Female]
If the morning tears them down
(Male) We'll make another one
(Duet) We'll make another one

[Chorus - Duet]
Paper moons, glowing soft and low
Holding on to what we used to know
